description: Utility functions for managing localStorage operations in a web application.

methods.name: saveToLocalStorage(key, value)
methods.description: Saves a key-value pair to localStorage.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key under which to store the value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to store in localStorage.

methods.returns: A boolean indicating whether the operation was successful.

methods.name: loadFromLocalStorage(key)
methods.description: Loads a value from localStorage based on a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key of the value to retrieve.

methods.returns: The value associated with the given key or an empty string if not found.

methods.name: removeFromLocalStorage(key)
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from localStorage.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key of the value to remove.

methods.returns: A boolean indicating whether the operation was successful.
